name: Plaid
description: Finance and Fintech: bank data connectivity API for account linking, transactions, balances, identity, assets and payment initiation.
access_notes: Signing up on the Plaid Dashboard immediately yields a client_id and secret with full Sandbox access. Production requires submitting a request via the Dashboard with company/use-case details and approval takes a couple of business days; free Trial plan and Limited Production tiers exist as intermediate steps. OAuth2 client_credentials (scope mcp:dashboard) is used only for the Dashboard MCP server.
mcp_notes: Two official Plaid MCP servers: a remote Dashboard MCP at https://api.dashboard.plaid.com/mcp/ (diagnostics/analytics, requires Production access) and a local sandbox MCP (mcp-server-plaid) in plaid/ai-coding-toolkit. No Plaid toolkit found in the Composio toolkits index (docs.composio.dev/toolkits).
uncertainty_notes: Composio toolkit absence based on grepping the full docs.composio.dev/toolkits index page for 'plaid' (no match).

evidence.note: 'create an account on the Plaid Dashboard... we'll provide a live client_id and secret'; endpoints require client_id+secret headers; 'You can request Production API access via the Dashboard'.
'Approval for the Production environment takes a couple of business days, and you'll need to provide more information about your company'; Sandbox is free and immediate.
Sandbox is free and fully featured, keys from the Dashboard; sandbox supports simulating webhooks (/sandbox webhook simulation, Limited Production request form).
Plaid offers two MCP servers: remote Dashboard MCP server at api.dashboard.plaid.com/mcp/ (OAuth client_credentials, mcp:dashboard scope) and a local development MCP server.
